core_obligations: Replace the test object: choose an algebraic space mapping onto the base of the given square, note that the composite with the flat family is flat and surjective, and use the base change formula for flatness to replace the test object by that space (proof lines 5397-5406)

Present the morphism: choose smooth presentations of the target and of the fibre product so that the induced morphism of algebraic spaces is smooth over the presentation of the source (proof lines 5407-5414)

Base change everything: after base changing by the given flat surjective morphism, the flatness hypothesis applies to the corresponding morphism of presentations, and flatness descends along the surjective morphism between the two presentations, giving flatness of the presenting morphism and hence of the morphism of stacks (proof lines 5415-5429)
proof_roadmap: 取概型/代数空间 W → Z 满光滑 ⇒ 复合 W → Y 满平坦；由平坦性的基变换公式可把测试对象换成 W。
再取 V → Y 满光滑、U → V ×_Y X 满光滑，只需证 U → V 平坦。
把一切沿 W → Y 基变换：U' → V' 平坦（由假设，按栈态射平坦的定义），而 V' → V 满，故由「平坦性沿满平坦基变换下降」得 U → V 平坦。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that flatness of a morphism of algebraic stacks can be checked after a flat surjective base change (author lemma at source lines 5388-5395, label lemma-descent-flat). The proof (source lines 5397-5430) replaces the test object by a smooth presentation, presents the morphism by algebraic spaces, base changes all the presentations along the given flat surjective morphism and descends flatness from the base-changed presenting morphism through the descent statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 5397-5429). The presentation of the morphism and the final descent step are the substance. H3.
